findings.title: Producer pin map is not required to equal the recorded full source/input union
findings.observed: Public main accepted after removing H_execution.json from P.pinned_sha256; C/A maps still supply its current hash during union so missing producer-time binding is masked.
findings.required: Require exact P map keys/values equal C.base107 union raw Q,C,primary-entry path/SHA, including all107 source/input pins; keep A auxiliary135 separate.

findings.title: Q actual qualification evidence is hashed without checking its semantic proof links
findings.observed: DINO-declared Q with raw-SHA-correct qualification candidate and independent audit that both say FAILED/CLIP still passed public main and all8 numeric cohorts.
findings.required: Parse accepted real aux schemas/status/backbone/use/receipt and identity links. Q candidate and its independent audit share their own qualification seed, which may differ from the result seed. Entry engineering review uses its actual long status/candidate_sha256 contract and has no backbone/schema.

findings.title: Public result acceptance has no primary true-exit or log/time terminal gate
findings.observed: Public main accepted while L.pid was the live fixture process and L.time_v contained Exit status1; the simulated producer held temporary slot0 while the audit acquired temporary slot1.
findings.required: Externally SHA-bind L.stdout/time_v, require root-recorded primary wrapper PID exited or zombie, unique time exit0 and sequential42 BEGIN lines plus canonical final COMPLETE publication; retain nonblocking original shared slot. Do not confuse earlier A admission PIDs with primary producer PIDs.
